name: Futa Healthcare
source:
"Futa Healthcare" is an erotic visual novel that dives into the world of healthcare for futa's, a realm where the line between noble and selfish intentions blurs. The game follows the journey of a young man who steps into this world, driven by a mix of altruistic and personal desires.

The protagonist, a young and ambitious individual, enters the complex realm of futa healthcare with a dual purpose: to make a difference in the lives of futa's and to satisfy his own curiosity and desires. As he navigates this intricate world, he will face challenges, make discoveries, and forge relationships that will shape his future and the future of those he serves.

[From F95Zones]
